name: docmesh
description: Offline-capable, recall-first document retrieval and consistency workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Find and verify documentation concepts across a project
interface.longDescription: DocMesh indexes Markdown, MDX, LaTeX, BibTeX, text, and text-bearing PDFs locally. It supports precision search and a recall-first global-edit workflow with source-validated locations, immutable baselines, and strict verification.
defaultPrompt: Set up DocMesh for this project and explain the corpus roles.
Search the indexed documentation for this concept.
Apply this conceptual documentation change with global discovery and verification.
